entries.name: RimWorld - Odyssey
entries.short_description: Build your own ship and travel across the planet! Explore exotic biomes, expand your mobile colony, and launch into space. Scavenge ancient tech on asteroids, abandoned space stations, and satellites. Find and defeat the mechanoid lair.
entries.coverage_qualification: Completed RimWorld intake names Anomaly/Biotech/Ideology/Odyssey/Royalty installers. Selected shared base-assembly methods do not establish expansion-package reading.

entries.name: RimWorld - Anomaly
entries.short_description: Darkness stirs on the rim. Survive flesh infestations, cultist attacks, shambling undead, blood rains, invisible hunters, and other sanity-shredding perils. Capture and study entities to harness the power of the void. Conduct psychic rituals and awaken an evil machine god.

entries.name: RimWorld - Biotech
entries.short_description: Control mechanoids, raise a family with children, and play with genetic modifications. Fight or ally with xenohuman factions and explore the dark secrets of the blood-drinkers.
entries.coverage_qualification: Completed RimWorld intake names Anomaly/Biotech/Ideology/Odyssey/Royalty installers. Selected shared base-assembly methods do not establish expansion-package reading.

entries.name: RimWorld - Ideology
entries.short_description: What do you believe? RimWorld - Ideology adds belief systems to the game. Play as piratical nudist cannibals, blind undergrounder mole people, charitable ranching cowboys, machine-obsessed transhumanists, and many more.
entries.coverage_qualification: Completed RimWorld intake names Anomaly/Biotech/Ideology/Odyssey/Royalty installers. Selected shared base-assembly methods do not establish expansion-package reading.

entries.name: RimWorld - Royalty
entries.short_description: The Empire has arrived. Earn royal titles through quests to receive psychic powers, unique technologies, and the aid of royal troops. Or, fight their hegemony, link with the mysterious anima tree, and use stolen psychic tech. Host the Imperial ruler well, and he will take you to the stars.

entries.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal - Ashes of Urh'Rok
entries.short_description: You are a demonic experiment, halted before completion! Use what remains of your free will to fight the demons with their own tools. Bring down pain and fire upon the demonic hordes... and any others that dare oppose you!
entries.coverage_qualification: Official metadata acquired, original expansion mechanics unread. Streets original base-game source is also unavailable.

entries.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal - Embers of Rage
entries.short_description: One year ago The Scourge from the West came and crushed most of the Orc Pride. Only few remnants of free Orcs exist on a small island, but their situation is dire! So grab you best steam gun, your rocket boots and carve a path through the Sunwall. Save the Orc Pride!
entries.coverage_qualification: Official metadata acquired, original expansion mechanics unread. Streets original base-game source is also unavailable.

entries.name: Tales of Maj'Eyal - Forbidden Cults
entries.short_description: Not all adventurers seek fortune, not all that defend the world have good deeds in mind. People wander off the beaten paths only to be found years later, horribly mutated and insane, if they are found at all. It is becoming evident something is stirring deep below Maj'Eyal. That something is you.
entries.coverage_qualification: Official metadata acquired, original expansion mechanics unread. Streets original base-game source is also unavailable.
